pages.text: A Patient Kiln takes one kind of thing at a time, puts the lid on, and waits. It counts in $(l)world days$(), on the world's clock, so it keeps working whether or not anyone is there to watch.$(br2)Right-click with something it knows to put it in. Right-click again to ask how long is left.

pages.title: When it is done
pages.text: The lid comes off and the finished work stands in the mouth, so you can see it from across the room. Right-click to take it, or let a hopper underneath pull it out.$(br2)A comparator reads 1 to 14 as the days run down, and 15 when something is ready. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take back what you put in; the wait so far is lost.
